entries.61ccb5d4130c705c: This is a holding company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries and 6 non-consolidated subsidiaries make up the group, and its single segment is home delivery of prepared food ingredients. The total store count across the chain is 695 (227 directly operated and 468 franchised), with 352 bases and 363 employees. In the home delivery business, the consolidated subsidiary RIDE ON EXPRESS Co., Ltd. is responsible for the franchise headquarters functions and the operation of directly operated stores.
